atom_bw_eoc_euptd.text: The EU Pay Directive: pay transparency measures for workers and employers, aimed at reducing unexplained gender pay gaps. All 27 EU member countries must adopt regulations by June 2026.
atom_bw_eoc_euptd.rationale: heading compressed; figures and dates preserved exactly

atom_bw_eoc_euptd_right_to_info.text: You have the right to ask your employer about your own pay level — and about average pay levels, broken down by gender, for people doing the same work or work of equal value.

flags.note: 'categories of workers' compressed to 'people' — the category framing is legal language; confirm it can go

atom_bw_eoc_euptd_right_to_info.rationale: re-addressed to second person; the right is granted by the atom, so 'you have the right' is re-addressing, not invention

atom_bw_faq_scope.text: Have questions about pay ranges in U.S. job postings? The Pay Transparency in U.S. job postings FAQ answers them — employee and manager questions alike — and includes a table of disclosure requirements, timing, and effective dates for each jurisdiction.
atom_bw_faq_scope.rationale: question-first reframe; FAQ title kept canonical

atom_bw_framework_p4p.rationale: question head rendered as a learner-facing head

atom_bw_framework_p4p_achieve.text: Your incentive payout starts with the plan formula, then moves up or down with your individual performance — as measured through Achieve.

atom_bw_framework_p4p_annual_incentives.text: Annual incentives are the main way a year's accomplishments get rewarded: they measure performance against established business goals, and your individual performance links directly to your final payout.

flags.note: 'primary compensation element' restructured to 'main way' — confirm the element framing isn't load-bearing

atom_bw_framework_p4p_annual_incentives.rationale: two sentences fused; the clear-link claim carried into the second clause

atom_bw_framework_p4p_base_role.text: Your base salary pays for the core expectations of your specific role.

atom_bw_framework_p4p_bpp.text: The Brunswick Performance Plan (BPP) is the key compensation tool behind our pay for performance culture — for the Company and for you. Most global salaried employees are eligible (the main exception: sales employees who earn commissions), and your bonus target is set by your salary grade.
atom_bw_framework_p4p_bpp.rationale: re-addressed; BPP and eligibility scope preserved exactly

atom_bw_framework_p4p_merit.text: Salary and merit reviews keep us following market trends and aligned to pay for performance — and your performance in a given year, high or low, shapes your salary increase.
atom_bw_framework_p4p_merit.rationale: re-addressed; the high-or-low symmetry kept (it de-threatens by being honest, not by softening)

atom_bw_framework_total_rewards.text: Total Rewards: More Than a Paycheck. Your total compensation includes benefits, bonuses, and company-provided offerings from Brunswick.
atom_bw_framework_total_rewards.rationale: head + sentence; 'so much more' toned to 'more' — the atom's enthusiasm survives in the head

atom_bw_framework_total_rewards_variable.text: A portion of your pay is variable compensation — with targets, like base salary, set from competitive market data. As you move up through the organization, the mix shifts: less base, more variable.
atom_bw_framework_total_rewards_variable.rationale: re-addressed; the pay-mix claim kept directional and exact

atom_bw_framework_total_rewards_variable.text: Commissions (for our employees who focus on sales)

atom_bw_framework_transparency_practices.text: How We Promote Pay Transparency. We're committed to pay transparency through our established practices and processes — and to enhancing those efforts, for fairness and clarity for you.
atom_bw_framework_transparency_practices.rationale: re-addressed close ('for you' renders the atom's 'for employees' to the learner)

atom_bw_framework_transparency_practices.text: Employee Visibility: your compensation details in Workday; your Total Rewards Statement; merit and bonus letters with your annual performance review.
atom_bw_framework_transparency_practices.rationale: re-addressed with possessives; Workday and statement names kept canonical

atom_bw_framework_trs.text: Your Total Rewards Statement: your total rewards in one personalized snapshot — find it in Workday under the Benefits and Pay app.
atom_bw_framework_trs.rationale: compressed; the Workday location kept exact

atom_bw_framework_trs_intl_note.text: If you're an international employee, note that the Total Rewards Statement doesn't currently capture every allowance and benefit.
atom_bw_framework_trs_intl_note.rationale: re-addressed; 'currently' kept — the limitation is the atom's claim, not softened away

atom_bw_guide_base_pay.text: How Your Base Pay Is Set

atom_bw_guide_base_pay_grades.text: Brunswick uses a traditional grade structure — 24 pay ranges, each closely tied to market rates through our compensation surveys and benchmarking exercises.

atom_bw_guide_base_pay_range.text: Every grade has a minimum, midpoint, and maximum, plus a market range for base salary — and its own target for incentive pay.
atom_bw_guide_base_pay_range.rationale: fused; all four range concepts kept

atom_bw_guide_base_pay_range_positions.text: Where people typically fall within the range:

flags.note: 'in different scenarios' dropped — the list items ARE the scenarios

atom_bw_guide_base_pay_range_positions_h.text: Higher in the range: long-term employees who have stayed in role, highly skilled or high-demand positions, and the highest sustained performers.

atom_bw_guide_base_pay_range_positions_l.text: Lower in the range: new hires with minimal experience, recent promotions into much larger jobs, roles newly placed in a grade by job evaluation, or performance below expectations.

flags.span: roles newly placed in a grade by job evaluation
flags.note: 'new to grade based on job evaluation' re-expressed — confirm the job-evaluation mechanism reads correctly

atom_bw_guide_base_pay_range_positions_l.rationale: the four scenarios kept; the register de-threatens by listing structural reasons before the performance one, as the source does

atom_bw_guide_base_pay_range_positions_m.text: Around the market median: successful performers who are “fully competent” in their role, and experienced new hires.

flags.note: the artisan control adds reassurance here ('a solid, positive place to be') — an evaluative claim NO atom carries; withheld per the invent line. If Brunswick wants it, it needs an atom (or acceptance-time authorship)

atom_bw_guide_base_pay_range_positions_m.rationale: the withheld reassurance is the honesty line working — see flag

atom_bw_guide_base_pay_zones.text: The grade structure splits into three geographic zones, each reflecting the cost of labor in different U.S. locations — accounting for the varied pay rates across our widespread locations.

atom_bw_guide_commitment.text: Brunswick is committed to open, informed conversations about compensation — they're part of a positive work environment.
atom_bw_guide_commitment.rationale: the commitment re-expressed conversationally; both claims kept

atom_bw_guide_commitment_laws.text: In 2025, several U.S. states implement new pay transparency laws — laws that require employers to disclose salary ranges and benefits in job postings or during the hiring process. The aim: pay equity, transparency, and fair compensation practices.
atom_bw_guide_commitment_laws.rationale: 'USA' rendered as U.S. (sibling-atom form); tense tightened to the course's present

atom_bw_guide_commitment_postings.text: New pay transparency laws take effect in 2025 — and we're proud to be including salary ranges and benefits information in all our new job postings.
atom_bw_guide_commitment_postings.rationale: the atom's future tense kept ('to be including'); pride kept, promises not added

atom_bw_guide_commitment_trust.text: Transparency builds trust. That's why we're preparing managers to have open, informed conversations about compensation.
atom_bw_guide_commitment_trust.rationale: split for rhythm; no addressee added — the atom doesn't say with whom

atom_bw_guide_philosophy_benchmarking.rationale: imperative head rendered as a noun head

atom_bw_guide_philosophy_benchmarking_ho.text: Accurate job descriptions keep roles aligned in compensation surveys, and market data from trusted sources is used to assess job value and total rewards programs. A total rewards mindset shapes a package that attracts and keeps top talent.
atom_bw_guide_philosophy_benchmarking_ho.rationale: kept close; this is philosophy language and resists heavy warming

atom_bw_guide_philosophy_equity.text: Balance External Competitiveness with Internal Equity

atom_bw_guide_philosophy_equity_how.text: Market data is a guide — but internal equity matters just as much. Every job is placed in the Brunswick grade structure based on both its external market data and its internal value.
atom_bw_guide_philosophy_equity_how.rationale: split for rhythm; both determinants kept

atom_bw_guide_philosophy_p4p.text: Link Pay to Individual, Team & Company Performance

flags.note: pillar name kept; the 'via Pay-for-Performance' tail is the mechanism the body explains

atom_bw_guide_philosophy_p4p_how.text: Exceptional performance gets recognized and rewarded — through annual merit increases and incentive plans — based on your individual contributions plus team and company performance.

flags.note: 'motivates employees and drives success' dropped as rhetorical framing — confirm it isn't wanted on screen

atom_bw_guide_stewardship.text: Shaping Pay as Part of Enterprise HR: the Compensation and Benefits team, in strong partnership with division HR teams, regularly reviews compensation data, benchmarks against market trends, and assesses internal pay levels — so pay stays fair and competitive for all employees.
atom_bw_guide_stewardship.rationale: long head split into head + sentence; the who and the activities kept complete

atom_bw_guide_stewardship_activities.text: Key activities at the enterprise level:

atom_bw_guide_stewardship_activities_2.text: Participate in market surveys to benchmark compensation against industry standards — and keep it competitive.
atom_bw_guide_stewardship_activities_2.rationale: close rendering; final clause re-addressed to purpose

atom_bw_guide_stewardship_activities_3.text: Perform on-demand and planned role analyses to assess job responsibilities, market value, and internal equity.
